VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month

VR.summary: Apple publishes technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing developer opportunities.

VR.summary: XREAL launches its first budget AR glasses internationally, priced at $300, making XR technology more accessible.

VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirms ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, potentially hinting at announcements at the upcoming Connect event.

VR.summary: Reports reveal that the now-defunct Vertigo Games Amsterdam was working on a Tomb Raider VR game before its cancellation.
